name: Modular Friends
short_description: Modular Friends is a Tbilisi-based community and recurring event series bringing together modular synthesis, experimental live improvisation, and collaborations with visual artists.
about: A meeting point for musicians, visual artists and curious audiences. Each edition creates room for new connections between instruments, people and spaces.

formats.title: Live sound
formats.description: Modular synthesis, experimental electronics and improvisation.

formats.title: Shared knowledge
formats.description: Workshops, conversations and introductions to modular synthesis.

archive_intro: An edition-by-edition archive of performances, line-ups and visual-artist credits is being assembled from original event documentation.

events.title: Modular Friends 011 — Synthesia Lab
events.description: Announced as Modular Friends 011 at Synthesia Lab, featuring modular synthesis, live improvisation and audiovisual collaborations.
events.artists: Neroli Kid / Giga Baindurashvili; William Tavadze; Lado Barnovi; Vaska; TeTe / Tetso / Vazha Marr; Masa Trippin / Shota / Wrong Fingers; AGAVA / Wayward Atom / Spilled Ambiences; Eddie Strxm; jam guests Marching Dog and Tamarma.
events.visual_artists: Skywalker; TusY; Progenol; Nenealism / Jamanita / Yoyo; She nocturne / Sophie Gvelukashvili.

events.title: Modular Friends at Jazz Club 1984
events.description: Modular Friends performed an opening set at 22:00, followed by a separate experimental improvisation by NIKAKOI, Rezo Kiknadze and Nika Gabadze at 23:30.
